paragraphs: I'm applying for the Head of Platform Engineering role at Acme Corp. For the last ten years I've led infrastructure teams and built the platforms product engineers ship on.

At GreenTech I built an internal developer platform from scratch. Deployment frequency went up 200% and availability reached 99.9%. I lead eight engineers across platform, reliability, and infrastructure.
Before that, at StartupCo, I ran the Kubernetes clusters behind 100K+ concurrent users and replaced hour-long deploys with a pipeline that finished in minutes.
I'd be glad to talk through how Acme Corp's platform team works today and where you want it to go.
